title: The Harmful chemical in the soil
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：harmful　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 harmful 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the tailor wrote of ① a harmful chemical in the soil in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② more harmful than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the harmful ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most harmful chemical in the soil anybody in the shop had ever seen, or so the order for November 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too harmful to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the harmful ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a harmful habit of the old man, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as harmful as the habit of the old man they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was harmful or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something harmful, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite harmful; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the harmful ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, in silence, she wrote of another harmful chemical in the soil in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more harmful than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most harmful habit of the old man in the whole shop, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the harmful ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有害（前置定语 a harmful chemical in the soil：1979 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件有害的物）
B. adj. 有害／致害（比较级 more harmful than：文中两处，一处比土壤里的有害物，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有害／致害（最高级 the most harmful：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有害（表语 too harmful to do：母亲觉得它太有害，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 致害（前置定语 a harmful habit of the old man：叔叔把整件事称作一桩致害的习惯）
F. adj. 致害（同级比较 as harmful as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老人有害的习惯相比）
G. adj. 致害（后置定语 something harmful：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 致害（受程度副词修饰 quite harmful：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a harmful chemical in the soil
the most harmful chemical in the soil anybody
a harmful habit of the old man
The most harmful habit of the old man in

answers.why: harmful 意为“有害”，1979 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件有害的物”，此处作前置定语 a harmful chemical in the soil。
harmful 意为“有害”，此处用比较级 more harmful than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
harmful 意为“有害”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说它是裁缝铺里最有害的一件，故用最高级 the most harmful chemical in the soil。
harmful 意为“有害”，母亲认为这件东西“太有害了，谁也用不上”，too harmful to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
harmful 意为“致害”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩致害的习惯”，此处作前置定语 a harmful habit of the old man。
harmful 意为“致害”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老人有害的习惯一样致害”，同级比较用 as harmful as。
harmful 意为“致害”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“致害的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something harmful。
harmful 意为“致害”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当致害”，quite 修饰原级 harmful。
harmful 意为“致害”，1989 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要致害”，故用比较级 more harmful than。
harmful 意为“致害”，母亲 1991 年说的是“整个裁缝铺里最致害的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most harmful habit of the old man。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件有害的物。（a harmful chemical in the soil）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有害。（more harmful than …）
母亲觉得它太有害，谁也用不上。（too harmful to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩致害的习惯。（a harmful habit of the old man）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老人有害的习惯一样致害。（as harmful as …）
到了 1986 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件致害的东西。（something harmful）
answers: In 1979 the tailor wrote of a harmful chemical in the soil in the order.
Everybody said it was more harmful than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too harmful to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a harmful habit of the old man.
He said nobody would call it as harmful as the habit of the old man they had once had.
By 1986 the order asked for nothing but something harmful.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 harmful 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the tailor wrote of a harmful chemical in the soil in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most harmful chemical in the soil in the shop, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too harmful to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a harmful habit of the old man, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite harmful, and everybody laughed.
The harmful ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
